_comment: NIH fellowship review rubric, post Jan-25-2025 three-factor format. Canonical home of the rubric encoding. Source URLs in /sources.md (grants.nih.gov revised fellowship review criteria + reviewer guidance PDF).

schema._comment: Self-declared schema. verify-gate.sh validates this document against it.

percentile_0_100.direction: lower is better; compared against the IC payline

rules: every factor.type must name a key in value_types
every value_type with kind=numeric declares min and max and reverse_scored
every value_type with kind=categorical declares values
exactly one factor has type categorical_commitment
no factor of type categorical_commitment carries min, max, or a numeric score

reverse_coding.applies_to: every item whose type has reverse_scored true
reverse_coding.persistence: raw and scored are stored side by side for every reverse-coded item

validator_contract.notes: type-aware, not range-only: numeric types check min <= value <= max for THAT type; categorical types check membership in values. The type name is an argument, never assumed.
